query: INSERT INTO project_provider_keys (project_id, provider, org_id, credential_id, weight) SELECT p, $2, $1, $3, w FROM unnest($4::uuid[], $5::smallint[]) AS t(p, w) ON CONFLICT (project_id, provider, credential_id) DO UPDATE SET weight = EXCLUDED.weight WHERE project_provider_keys.weight <> EXCLUDED.weight
